newsitem.title: FINLAND: SAK CHAIRMAN SAYS REAL EARNINGS TREND KEY IN EMU.
newsitem.headline: SAK CHAIRMAN SAYS REAL EARNINGS TREND KEY IN EMU.

text.p: Lauri Ihalainen, chairman of the Central Organisation of Finnish Trade Unionsd (SAK) said on Monday that the trend in real earnings would be moree important than the trend in nominal wages in an EMU environment.
"Instead of nominal wages, we should in the future focus on a steady trend in real earnings," Ihalainen told a news conference in connection with an EMU seminar arranged by SAK.

Ihalainen repeated the SAK's view that a firm commitment to low inflation would be a central element for Finland to succeed in the European economic and monetary union (EMU). --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
